{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_deduped = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check the severity values for the deduplicated data
print(trial_df_deduped['severity'].value_counts())

# Check the biomarker_baseline column for non-numeric values
non_numeric = trial_df_deduped[~trial_df_deduped['biomarker_baseline'].apply(lambda x: isinstance(x, (int, float)))]
print("Non-numeric entries in biomarker_baseline:")
print(non_numeric)

# Check the data type of biomarker_baseline
print("Data type of biomarker_baseline:", trial_df_deduped['biomarker_baseline'].dtype)

# Check if there are any missing values in biomarker_baseline for SEVERE patients
severe_patients = trial_df_deduped[trial_df_deduped['severity'] == 'SEVERE']
print("Missing values in biomarker_baseline for SEVERE patients:", severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum())

# Try to compute the mean again with explicit float conversion
severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] = pd.to_numeric(severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'], errors='coerce')
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_biomarker_severe"}
